propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses) have no active reader after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port and its classify_probe_response consumer
The keys were live and behaviour-affecting in shipped release v0.10.1 where adapters/jira/probe.py::_resolve_resolved_statuses read jira.resolved_statuses, and operators were documented to set them

The decision is to deprecate both keys rather than hard-remove them, keeping them accepted and validated while adding deprecation warnings and deferring removal to a follow-up ticket requiring operator sign-off

The implementation removes write-only DataCenter transport plumbing (_TransportBase.resolved_statuses param, _resolved_statuses attribute, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES constant) while maintaining config parsing and adding scheduled retirement warnings targeting v1.0.0 removal
